summary: Iteration 29: Plan-Based Subscription Management - All features verified. Backend: 14/14 tests passed. Frontend: All plan-based UI features working correctly.

Backend: Enterprise annual_price is 37990 (not 49990)
Backend: Starter plan limits correct - max_companies=1, max_employees=2, 5 features
Backend: Professional plan limits correct - max_companies=3, max_employees=5, 8 features
Backend: Enterprise plan limits correct - max_companies=10, max_employees=20, 10 features
Backend: SuperAdmin login with superadmin/superadmin123 works
Backend: GET /api/super-admin/admins returns plan, max_companies, max_employees fields
Backend: POST /api/super-admin/admins with plan=starter creates admin with correct limits
Backend: POST /api/super-admin/admins with plan=professional creates admin with correct limits
Backend: POST /api/super-admin/admins with plan=enterprise creates admin with correct limits
Backend: Login response includes plan, max_companies, max_employees fields
Backend: Employee limit enforced for starter plan (max 2 employees)
Backend: POST /api/super-admin/prospects/{id}/convert with plan creates admin with correct limits
Backend: GET /api/public/demo-data returns sample data for Professional plan features
Frontend: Landing page pricing shows Enterprise annual ~Rs.3,166/mo (37990/12)
Frontend: Landing page pricing shows 'Billed Rs.37,990/year' for Enterprise
Frontend: SuperAdmin dashboard loads with Admin Management tab
Frontend: Admin cards show plan badges (ENTERPRISE, STARTER)
Frontend: Admin cards show employee limits (e.g., 1/20 employees)
Frontend: Admin cards show company limits (e.g., 2/10 companies)
Frontend: Admin cards show features count (e.g., 10/10 features)
Frontend: New Admin modal shows 3 plan cards (Starter, Professional, Enterprise)
Frontend: New Admin modal shows billing cycle toggle (Monthly/Annual with 17% savings)
Frontend: New Admin modal shows plan features preview

Frontend: Convert modal shows company/employee limits per plan

Frontend: Signup demo step shows 8 Professional features listed
Frontend: Signup demo step shows video player element
Frontend: Signup demo step shows Enterprise upgrade message

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 29 validated plan-based subscription management. Key findings: 1) Enterprise annual price is Rs.37,990 (not 49990). 2) Plans auto-set features, max_companies, max_employees. 3) SuperAdmin can create admins with plan selection (Starter/Professional/Enterprise). 4) Admin cards show plan badges with color coding. 5) Convert modal allows plan selection when converting prospects. 6) Employee limit is enforced based on plan (starter=2, professional=5, enterprise=20). 7) Company limit is enforced on sync (starter=1, professional=3, enterprise=10). 8) Demo page shows Professional plan features banner with 8 features. 9) Video player element present in demo section.
